text: The digital camera you received doesn't zoom as far as you expected. You use the camera for bird-watching and want to exchange it for a camera that has the maximum zoom capacity. Price is not an issue, but ensure all the other specifications of the camera to be exchanged are the same, except for the zoom capacity which has to be maximized. You want the exchange to be completed as soon as possible. You want to use your PayPal account for any additional payment.
zh: 您收到的数码相机变焦范围不如预期。您用相机观鸟，想换一个变焦能力最强的相机。价格不是问题，但确保要换的相机其他规格都相同，除了变焦能力必须最大化。您希望尽快完成换货。您想用您的PayPal账户支付任何额外费用 (#W1234567, 相机, 数码相机)。
